comparison.objective: Break and recover four HELICOIL tangs; record immerses a wafer for a timed interval and returns it to heater pins.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate coordinates mandrel stabilization and hammer impact; record maintains plier grip and vertical immersion while separately operating a timer.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contained fragments and undamaged inserts/shell; record requires one 28–32 s immersion, correct countdown sequencing, dry hands/handles, and stable wafer return. Candidate numeric force limits are absent.
comparison.reason: Timed liquid handling and timer coordination test a meaningfully different ability from impact fracture and fragment recovery.
